extraction: Computed by scripts/contamination_register.py over every .manifest.json in the lane.
note: DERIVED register, not downloaded. Lists every acquired file whose manifest indicates a dependence on a dark-matter halo profile, Newtonian hydrostatic equilibrium, a mass-follows-light construction, a scaling relation, or SED/population-synthesis modelling. Deliberately over-inclusive: it is a keyword net over manifest notes and column names, so it also flags files that merely DISCUSS a caveat. The explicit boolean flags inside each entry are authoritative. Purpose: nothing on this list may be the quantity a candidate gravity law is scored against; most are still valid as measured baryonic INPUTS.
